integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically. The accompanying numerical script is only a finite sanity check and is not used as evidence for the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Only the \(p=3\), \(q=8n+1\) subfamily with \(n\ge2\) is proved.
No uniqueness claim is made for the extremizer.
Non-indexed literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact second discrete Fejér constant on the \(q=8n+1\) grid at degree two
